name: Brimming Pail
text: After bidding, if you have five or more cards of one suit, gain +15 contract value.

signature.effect: contract value +15 if you hold five of one suit

archetypes: Spade Master, Diamond Flood, Heart Chorus
family: Voids, singletons, and long suits / Long-suit thresholds
decision: Aiming conversions and passes to reach five cards of a suit.
opponent: Visible at the trigger; opponents learn you hold a long spade or diamond suit.
aiNote: Convert toward whichever of spades or diamonds is longer until it reaches five.
rationale: About 60% of natural hands hold five of one suit, and conversions push it near certain, so +15 is about +10 EV, the common budget. One suit of any kind keeps it to one condition.
deviation: Narrowed from five spades or five diamonds to five of any one suit, so it reads as one condition.
